verses.en: For I say unto you, that ye shall not see me henceforth and know that I am he of whom it is written by the prophets, until ye shall say: Blessed is he who cometh in the name of the Lord, in the clouds of heaven, and all the holy angels with him. Then understood his disciples that he should come again on the earth, after that he was glorified and crowned on the right hand of God.
verses.sm: Aua Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a outou lē vaai mai ia te a’u mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma ma iloa o A’u o ia o lē ua tusi i ai perofeta, seia outou fai ane: Faamanu lava ia te ia o lē ua maliu mai i le suafa o le Alii, i ao o le lagi, ma agelu paia uma faatasi ma ia. Ona malamalama ai lea o ona soo o le a toe afio mai o ia i le lalolagi, pe a uma ona faamamaluina ma faapaleina o ia i le lima taumatau o le Atua.

verses.en: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple; and his disciples came to him, for to hear him, saying: Master, show us concerning the buildings of the temple, as thou hast said—They shall be thrown down, and left unto you desolate.
verses.sm: Ma sa ulufafo atu Iesu, ma afio ese mai le malumalu; ma sa o ane ona soo ia te ia, e fia faalogologo ia te ia, ua faapea atu: Le Matai e, faaali mai ia te i matou e uiga i fale o le malumalu, e pei ona e fetalai mai— O le a soloia i latou i lalo, ma tuua tuufua ia te outou.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them: See ye not all these things, and do ye not understand them? Verily I say unto you, there shall not be left here, upon this temple, one stone upon another that shall not be thrown down.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou: Tou te le vaai atu ea i nei mea uma, ma outou le malamalama i ai? E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a le toe i ai iinei, i luga o lenei malumalu, se maa e tasi i luga o le isi e lē soloia i lalo.

verses.en: And Jesus left them, and went upon the Mount of Olives. And as he sat upon the Mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying: Tell us when shall these things be which thou hast said concerning the destruction of the temple, and the Jews; and what is the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world, or the destruction of the wicked, which is the end of the world?
verses.sm: Ma sa tuua e Iesu i latou, ma afio a’e i le Mauga o Olive. Ma a’o nofo o ia i luga o le Mauga o Olive, sa o ane ona soo ia te ia na’o i latou, ua faapea atu: Ta’u mai ia te i matou po o afea e oo mai ai ia mea na e fetalai mai ai e uiga i le faatafunaga o le malumalu, ma tagata Iutaia; ma o le a foi le faailoga o lou afio mai, ma le iuga o le lalolagi, po o le faaumatiaga o e e amioleaga, o le iuga lea o le lalolagi?

verses.en: And Jesus answered, and said unto them: Take heed that no man deceive you;
verses.sm: Ma sa tali atu Iesu, ma fetalai atu ia te i latou: Ia faaeteete ia lē faaseseina outou e se tagata;

verses.en: For many shall come in my name, saying—I am Christ—and shall deceive many;
verses.sm: Aua e toatele o le a o mai i lo’u igoa, ma faapea— o a’u o Keriso— ma o le a faaseseina ai le toatele;

verses.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you, and ye shall be hated of all nations, for my name’s sake;
verses.sm: Ona latou tuuina atu ai lea o outou ia faapuapuagatiaina, ma fasioti ia te outou, ma o le a itagia outou e atunuu uma, ona o lo’u igoa;

verses.en: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another;
verses.sm: Ma ona tausuai ai lea o le toatele, ma o le a faalata le tasi i le isi, ma o le a inoino le tasi i le isi;

verses.en: And many false prophets shall arise, and shall deceive many;
verses.sm: Ma e toatele perofeta pepelo o le a tutulai mai, ma o le a latou faaseseina le toatele;

verses.en: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold;
verses.sm: Ma ona o le a tele le amioleaga, o le a faasolo ina faaitiitia le alofa o le toatele;

verses.en: But he that remaineth steadfast and is not overcome, the same shall be saved.
verses.sm: Ae o ia o le e nofo tumau ma lē faatoilaloina, o ia lava lea o le a faaolaina.

verses.en: When you, therefore, shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, concerning the destruction of Jerusalem, then you shall stand in the holy place; whoso readeth let him understand.
verses.sm: O lea, a outou vaai i le inosia o le faatafunaga, na fetalai ai Tanielu le perofeta, e faatatau i le faafanoga o Ierusalema, ona outou tutulai lea i le mea paia; ’ai se e faitau ia tuu atu ia te ia ia malamalama.

verses.en: Then let them who are in Judea flee into the mountains;
verses.sm: Ona tuu atu lea ia i latou o e o i ai i Iutaia ia sosola i mauga;

verses.en: Let him who is on the housetop flee, and not return to take anything out of his house;
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te ia o lē ua i luga o le tumutumu o le fale ia sola ese, ma ia le foi mai e ave se mea i fafo mai lona fale;

verses.en: Neither let him who is in the field return back to take his clothes;
verses.sm: Pe tuu atu ia te ia o lē o i le fanua e foi atu e ave ona ofu;

verses.en: And wo unto them that are with child, and unto them that give suck in those days;
verses.sm: Ma oi talofa ia te i latou e maitaga, ma i latou o e e failelele i aso na;

verses.en: Therefore, pray ye the Lord that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the Sabbath day;
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou tatalo atu i le Alii ia lē i le taumalulu la outou sola’aga, pe i le aso Sapati foi;

verses.en: For then, in those days, shall be great tribulation on the Jews, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, such as was not before sent upon Israel, of God, since the beginning of their kingdom until this time; no, nor ever shall be sent again upon Israel.
verses.sm: Aua o le taimi lea, i na aso, o le a i ai le puapuaga tele i luga o tagata Iutaia, ma luga o e e nonofo i Ierusalema, sa lei faapea ona oo atu muamua i luga o Isaraelu, e le Atua, talu mai le amataga o lo latou malo seia oo mai i le taimi nei; e leai, pe toe auina atu lava i luga o Isaraelu.

verses.en: All things which have befallen them are only the beginning of the sorrows which shall come upon them.
verses.sm: O mea uma ua pa’u’ū ifo ia te i latou ua na’o se amataga o faanoanoaga ia o le a oo mai i o latou luga.

verses.en: And except those days should be shortened, there should none of their flesh be saved; but for the elect’s sake, according to the covenant, those days shall be shortened.
verses.sm: Ma vagana ai ua faapupuuina na aso, o le a leai se tagata o i latou e faaolaina; ae ona o e ua filifilia, e tusa ma le feagaiga, o le a faapupuuina na aso.

verses.en: Behold, these things I have spoken unto you concerning the Jews; and again, after the tribulation of those days which shall come upon Jerusalem, if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there, believe him not;
verses.sm: Faauta, o nei mea ua Ou tautala atu ai ia te outou e faatatau i tagata Iutaia; ma le tasi, a mavae le puapuagatia o aso na o le a oo mai i luga o Ierusalema, afai e fai mai se tagata ia te outou, Faauta, o iinei Keriso, po o iina, aua nei talitonu ia te ia;

verses.en: For in those days there shall also arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders, insomuch, that, if possible, they shall deceive the very elect, who are the elect according to the covenant.
verses.sm: Aua i aso na o le a tutulai a’e ai foi Keriso pepelo, ma perofeta pepelo, ma o le a latou faaali mai faailoga tetele ma mea e ofo ai, e oo ina a mafai, o le a latou faaseseina ai lava e ua filifilia, o e ua filifilia e tusa ma le feagaiga.

verses.en: Behold, I speak these things unto you for the elect’s sake; and you also shall hear of wars, and rumors of wars; see that ye be not troubled, for all I have told you must come to pass; but the end is not yet.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua Ou tautala atu nei mea ia te outou ona o e ua filifilia; ma o le a outou faalogo foi i taua ma tala o taua; vaai ia lē faaatuatuvaleina outou, aua o mea uma ua Ou ta’u atu ia te outou o le a faataunuuina lava; peitai e lei oo mai lava le iuga.

verses.en: Behold, I have told you before;
verses.sm: Faauta, sa Ou ta’u muamua atu ia te outou;

verses.en: Wherefore, if they shall say unto you: Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: Behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, afai latou te fai mai ia te outou: Faauta, ua i ai o ia i le toafa; aua tou te o i ai: Faauta, ua i ai o ia i afeafe faalilolilo; aua tou te talitonu i ai;

verses.en: For as the light of the morning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west, and covereth the whole earth, so shall also the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.sm: Aua e pei ona sau le malamalama o le taeao mai sasa’e, ma susulu atu lava i sisifo, ma sulugia ai le lalolagi atoa, o le a faapea foi le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata.

verses.en: And now I show unto you a parable. Behold, wheresoever the carcass is, there will the eagles be gathered together; so likewise shall mine elect be gathered from the four quarters of the earth.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te faaali atu ia te outou se faataoto. Faauta, soo se mea e i ai se tino mate, o iina e aofaga faatasi i ai aeto; o le a faapena foi ona faapotopotoina o la’u au filifilia mai itu e fa o le lalolagi.

verses.en: And they shall hear of wars, and rumors of wars.
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou faalogo i taua, ma tala o taua.

verses.en: Behold I speak for mine elect’s sake; for nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te tautala atu ona o la’u ’au filifilia; aua o le a tulai a’e le atunuu e faasaga i le tasi atunuu, ma le malo e faasaga i le tasi malo; o le a i ai oge, ma faama’i, ma mafuie, i nofoaga eseese.

verses.en: And again, because iniquity shall abound, the love of men shall wax cold; but he that shall not be overcome, the same shall be saved.
verses.sm: Ma o lea foi, ona o le a tele le amioleaga, o le a faasolo ina faaitiitia le alofa o tagata; ae o ia o lē e lē faatoilaloina, o ia lava lea o le a faaolaina.

verses.en: And again, this Gospel of the Kingdom shall be preached in all the world, for a witness unto all nations, and then shall the end come, or the destruction of the wicked;
verses.sm: Ma o lea foi, o lenei Talalelei o le Malo o le a tala’i atu i le lalolagi atoa, mo se molimau i atunuu uma, ma ona oo mai ai lea o le iuga, po o le faaumatiaga o e e amioleaga;

verses.en: And again shall the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ma o lea foi o le mea inosia e faatafuna ai, na tautala i ai le perofeta o Tanielu, o le a faataunuuina.

verses.en: And immediately after the tribulation of those days, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.sm: Ma i le taimi lava pe a mavae atu le puapuagatia o na aso, o le a faapouliuligia le la, ma o le a lē faasusuluina mai e le masina lona malamalama, ma o le a pa’u’ū ifo fetu mai le lagi, ma o le a lūlūina ai mana o le lagi.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto you, this generation, in which these things shall be shown forth, shall not pass away until all I have told you shall be fulfilled.
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o lenei tupulaga, lea o le a faaali atu ai nei mea, o le a lē mavae atu seia faataunuuina mea uma ua Ou fai atu ai ia te outou.

verses.en: Although, the days will come, that heaven and earth shall pass away; yet my words shall not pass away, but all shall be fulfilled.
verses.sm: E ui i lea, e oo mai aso, o le a mavae atu ai le lagi ma le lalolagi; ae o a’u upu o le a le mavae atu lava, ae o le a faataunuuina uma.

verses.en: And, as I said before, after the tribulation of those days, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken, then shall appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven, and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn; and they shall see the Son of Man coming in the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory;
verses.sm: Ma, e pei ona Ou muai fai atu, a mavae le puapuagatia o na aso, ma lūlūina mana o le lagi, ona vaaia ai lea o le faailoga o le Atalii o le Tagata i le lagi, ma ona faavauvau ai lea o ituaiga uma o le lalolagi; ma o le a latou vaai i le Atalii o le Tagata ua afio mai i ao o le lagi, ma le mana ma le mamalu tele;

verses.en: And whoso treasureth up my word, shall not be deceived, for the Son of Man shall come, and he shall send his angels before him with the great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together the remainder of his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.sm: Ma ai se na te teu faaoloaina taua a’u upu, o le a lē faaseseina, aua o le a afio mai le Atalii o le Tagata, ma o le a ia auina mai ana agelu i luma o ia ma le leo tele o se pu, ma o le a latou aofaga faatasi le vaega o totoe o lana ’au filifilia mai matagi e fa, mai le tasi tuluiga o le lagi i le isi.

verses.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree—When its branches are yet tender, and it begins to put forth leaves, you know that summer is nigh at hand;
verses.sm: O lea ia a’oa’o i se faataoto e uiga i le laau o le mati— A’o mu’amu’a lava ona lala, ma amata ona ia faafotu mai lau, tou te iloa ai ua latalata lava ona oo mai le tau mafanafana;

verses.en: So likewise, mine elect, when they shall see all these things, they shall know that he is near, even at the doors;
verses.sm: E faapena foi, la’u ’au filifilia, pe a latou vaai i nei mea uma, o le a latou iloa ua lata mai o ia, ua i faitotoa lava;

verses.en: But of that day, and hour, no one knoweth; no, not the angels of God in heaven, but my Father only.
verses.sm: Ae i lena aso, ma le itula, e leai se tasi na te iloaina; e leai, e le iloa e agelu a le Atua i le lagi, ae nao lo’u Tamā lava.

verses.en: But as it was in the days of Noah, so it shall be also at the coming of the Son of Man;
verses.sm: Ae e pei ona sa i ai i aso o Noa, o le a faapea foi ona i ai i le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata;

verses.en: For it shall be with them, as it was in the days which were before the flood; for until the day that Noah entered into the ark they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage;
verses.sm: Ona o le a i ai ia te i latou, e pei ona sa i ai i aso ao lei oo mai le lolo; auā seia oo mai i le aso na ulu ai Noa i totonu o le vaa sa latou aai ma inu, faaipoipo ma tuuina atu i le faaipoipoga;

verses.en: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Man be.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou lē iloa seia oo ina sau le lolo, ma aveesea i latou uma; o le a faapena foi ona i ai i le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata.

verses.en: Then shall be fulfilled that which is written, that in the last days, two shall be in the field, the one shall be taken, and the other left;
verses.sm: Ona faataunuuina ai lea o le mea ua tusia, e faapea i aso e gata ai, e toalua o le a i ai i le fanua, o le a aveina le tasi, ma e tuua le isi;

verses.en: Two shall be grinding at the mill, the one shall be taken, and the other left;
verses.sm: E toalua o le a olo i le mea olo saito, o le a aveina le tasi, ma e tuua le isi;

verses.en: And what I say unto one, I say unto all men; watch, therefore, for you know not at what hour your Lord doth come.
verses.sm: Ma o le mea Ou te fai atu ai i le toatasi, Ou te fai atu ai i tagata uma; o lea, ia mataala ai, auā tou te le iloa le itula e afio mai ai lo outou Alii.

verses.en: But know this, if the good man of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to have been broken up, but would have been ready.
verses.sm: Ae ia outou iloa le mea lenei, a na fai e iloa e le matai o le fale le itupo e sau ai le gaoi, semanu e vaavaai o ia, ma semanu e le tuua lona fale ia lepetia, ae manu o saunia.

verses.en: Therefore be ye also ready, for in such an hour as ye think not, the Son of Man cometh.
verses.sm: O lea ia outou saunia foi, ona o se itula faapea tou te lē manatu i ai, e afio mai ai le Atalii o le Tagata.

verses.en: Who, then, is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.sm: O ai, la, o se auauna faamaoni ma le poto, o lē ua faia e lona alii e pule i lona auaiga, e tuu atu ia te i latou meaai i le tau e tatau ai?

verses.en: Blessed is that servant whom his lord, when he cometh, shall find so doing; and verily I say unto you, he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.sm: Amuia lava lena auauna o lē e maua mai e lona alii, pe a afio mai o ia, o faia faapea e ia; ma e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le a faia e ia o ia ma pule i ana mea uma.

verses.en: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart: My lord delayeth his coming,
verses.sm: Ae afai e fai ifo lena auauna leaga i lona loto: Ua faatuai e lo’u alii lona afio mai,

verses.en: And shall begin to smite his fellow-servants, and to eat and drink with the drunken,
verses.sm: Ma amata ona ia sasa ona uso-a-auauna, ma ’ai ma inu faatasi ma e onanā,

verses.en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.sm: O le a afio mai le alii o lena auauna i se aso pe a lē vaavaai o ia mo ia, ma i se itula e lē iloa e ia,

verses.en: And shall cut him asunder, and shall appoint him his portion with the hypocrites; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.sm: Ma o le a vavae ese o ia, ma o le a tofi ia te ia lana vaega faatasi ma e e talapepelo; o iina o le a i ai le tagiauē ma le lilivau o nifo.

verses.en: And thus cometh the end of the wicked, according to the prophecy of Moses, saying: They shall be cut off from among the people; but the end of the earth is not yet, but by and by.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapea ona oo mai le iuga o e amioleaga, e tusa ma le valoaga a Mose, ua faapea: O le a vavae ese i latou mai totonu o le nuu; peitai e lei oo mai lava i le iuga o le lalolagi, ae ua lata mai lava.
